summary:
## [1.5.0] - 2026-11-12

Release 1.5.0. DMX lighting: stage and architectural fixtures, moving heads included, over Art-Net or sACN nodes or
an ENTTEC DMX USB Pro, patched from the Open Fixture Library or a GDTF file. Groups of fixtures are rows on the
staff Lights pane, a programmer sets anything a fixture can do, and saved looks are the groups' scenes and preset
steps. Also: an assessment of what Lutron support would take (docs/lutron.md). Docs: user guide 4.17, how-to 38 and
39, troubleshooting 10.

### Added

- **DMX plugin.** Outputs: Art-Net (nodes found with ArtPoll), sACN (multicast or unicast, with priority) and the
  ENTTEC DMX USB Pro. Each universe is sent on change at up to 40 frames a second and re-sent every second.
- **Fixture library.** Search the Open Fixture Library (656 fixtures from 138 manufacturers) and add a definition;
  upload a GDTF file from the manufacturer or gdtf-share.com; use the built-in generic profiles (dimmers,
  RGB/RGBW/RGBA, tunable white); or type a custom channel list. Added definitions stay on the server, so the venue
  needs no internet afterwards.
- **Patch.** Fixtures are patched at their start addresses with clash checks and the next free address.
- **Groups.** A group is one Lights pane row: on/off, level, colour and white mixed for each fixture type (RGB with
  white and amber, CMY, the nearest colour-wheel slot, warm/cool, CTO).
- **Looks.** Looks fade in and are a group's scenes. Whole-rig looks sit on the admin-only "All DMX" group for
  presets.
- **Programmer.** Intensity, beam, colour and white, a pan/tilt pad, and a button for every wheel, gobo, shutter and
  macro slot from the fixture's definition. **Locate** lights a fixture up to find it. A channel monitor shows the
  512 values of a universe live.
- **The rig comes back after a restart.** The server is the only source on its universes and restores its last
  state.
- **Windows:** the installer and the plugin open UDP 6454 for Art-Net node replies; `serialport` ships as an
  optional module for USB interfaces.
- **Behaviour settings.** **Fade for staff changes (seconds)**, **Restore the rig after a restart** and **Show All
  DMX to staff**.
- **Outputs show what they are doing.** Each output lists its frame count or its error. An output that cannot open
  (a node's socket, a USB port) is tried again every few seconds, and an sACN output tells its receivers when it
  stops.
- **Fixture defaults.** Channels nobody has set carry the definition's own defaults, so a moving head starts with
  pan and tilt centred and its shutter open. Fixtures without a dimmer channel dim through their colour channels.
- **Setup checklist** row for DMX (listed only while the plugin is enabled) and **System health** fix text for an
  output with an error and for a fixture whose definition is missing.
- **Control Devices › Lighting:** the DMX card now opens the plugin.
- **Network.** Art-Net goes out on UDP 6454 and sACN on UDP 5568 (multicast 239.255.x.x or unicast). On Linux the
  service user must be in the `dialout` group to use a USB interface.
- **API.** Admin routes under `/api/plugins/dmx`: the fixture library, the patch, the programmer, looks, Art-Net
  discovery and the channel monitor.
- **Demo mode.** A demo rig (two RGBW pars, a moving head, four dimmers, two looks) on a built-in Art-Net node.
